Definition: to turn about or over; by implication, to change, overturn, return, pervert
BiblicalUsage: 1) to turn, overthrow, overturn; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to overturn, overthrow; 1a2) to turn, turn about, turn over, turn around; 1a3) to change, transform; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to turn oneself, turn, turn back; 1b2) to change oneself; 1b3) to be perverse; 1b4) to be turned, be turned over, be changed, be turned against; 1b5) to be reversed; 1b6) to be overturned, be overthrown; 1b7) to be upturned; 1c) (Hithpael); 1c1) to transform oneself; 1c2) to turn this way and that, turn every way; 1d) (Hophal) to turn on someone
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
